title: Privacy Policy
description: This policy describes how {name} collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

collection.title: Information we collect
collection.body: We collect information you provide when you create an account (such as name and email), usage data necessary to operate the service, and technical data such as IP address and device type for security and reliability.

usage.title: How we use information
usage.body: We use your information to provide and improve {name}, authenticate users, send transactional emails (such as verification and password reset), and protect against abuse.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy-related questions about {name}, contact us through the support channels listed in the application.
